instruction: Use rsyslog to send logs to Fluentd via TCP
output:
<think>
So we need to use rsyslog to send logs to Fluentd via TCP.
Here's how I'd approach this.
Using && for chaining ensures if any step fails, the whole thing stops — safer than running separately.
</think>
echo 'template(name="Fluentd" type="string" string="%msg%\n")' > /etc/rsyslog.d/fluentd.conf && echo '*.* action(type="omfwd" target="127.0.0.1" port="24224" protocol="tcp" template="Fluentd")' >> /etc/rsyslog.d/fluentd.conf
